errors.bad_args: The error report got arguments it cannot read: {reason}

findings.deprecation_only: Deprecated feature used: {text} ({source}) - only in views: {views}
findings.http_not_found_only: Resource not found: {text} - only in views: {views}
findings.mixed_content_blocked_only: Mixed content blocked: {text} - only in views: {views}
findings.mixed_content_passive_only: Mixed content loaded or upgraded: {text} - only in views: {views}

panel.noCapture: The report receives nothing yet: the app does not hand this plugin the views' errors.
panel.published: Report written to .rbrowser/out/error-report/ and the findings panel.
panel.reloaded: Reloaded {count, plural, one {# view} other {# views}}; the report shows the fresh load.

ignore.description: Glob patterns (* any text, ? one character, case-blind) matched against an error's URL, source and text; a match leaves the error out of the report and the findings.
ignore.help: Glob patterns (* any text, ? one character, case-blind) matched against an error's URL, source and text; a match leaves the error out. Example: *analytics.js*, *ResizeObserver loop*.
ignore.label: Ignore patterns

reloadBeforeReport.description: Report now reloads the views and waits until their network is idle, so the report covers one fresh load.
reloadBeforeReport.help: Report now reloads the views and waits for a quiet network first, so the report covers one fresh load instead of everything since the session started.
reloadBeforeReport.label: Reload before the report

rules.description: Per category (js-exception, http-not-found, http-server-error, mixed-content-blocked, mixed-content-passive, csp-violation, deprecation): off, or the severity it gets.
rules.help: Per category (js-exception, http-not-found, http-server-error, mixed-content-blocked, mixed-content-passive, csp-violation, deprecation): off, or the severity its findings get. Example: deprecation to info.
rules.label: Categories and severities

sinceNavigation.description: Only what a view reported since its page last loaded counts; off, everything still in the capture does.
sinceNavigation.help: Only what a view reported since its page last loaded counts. When off, it includes everything still in the capture, across navigations.
sinceNavigation.label: Since the page loaded

thirdParty.description: Errors of resources and scripts from other sites than the view's page count too.
thirdParty.help: Errors of resources and scripts from other sites than the view's page count too. When off, it reports the site's own only.
thirdParty.label: Include third-party origins

tools.clear: Clears the error report: what the views reported so far leaves it.
tools.get: The error report over the views as JSON: JS exceptions, 404/410 and 5xx resources, mixed content, CSP violations and deprecations, deduplicated with the views that reported each (onlyIn when not all did), with source, stack and request. reload: true reloads the targeted views and waits for network idle instead; call again for the report of the fresh load. limit caps the entries (default 500).
